interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this agent skill or skill repository for security risks, spec compliance, and provider compatibility. Do not execute its code; ground findings in source evidence.
interface.longDescription: Guided workflows inspired by yu-iskw/skill-inspector for evaluating agent skills against the Agent Skills specification, checking for security and supply-chain risks, assessing provider portability, and producing evidence-backed reports. This guidance does not claim that the upstream CLI has run unless tool execution is actually available.

name: skill-inspector
description: Inspect AI agent skills for specification compliance, security risks, and provider compatibility before adopting them.
